<div id="n-sof" popover class="note">
  <h3>Independent analytics practice, Stats Over Fiction</h3>
  <ul>
    <li>Build and run a private multi-sport projections platform, PostgreSQL-backed, with daily ingestion through projection and calibration.</li>
    <li>Leaderboards for eleven sports, every row scored against a stated baseline; pre-registered experiments that score their holdout once.</li>
    <li>Append-only data design with explicit casting and timestamped run logs; calibration and backtests check model output against results.</li>
    <li>Broward County rental study: 20,575 entire-home listings across four quarterly snapshots, clustered with Gaussian mixture models and profiled by revenue.</li>
    <li>Structural causal model audit of a production NBA pipeline, using d-separation to separate causal signals from merely correlated ones.</li>
  </ul>
